label: Every CONTINGENCY_1 being at w is existentially receptive or has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse
paraphrase: OPEN weak form of C2 (C2-minus), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every candidate contingent at w is existentially receptive (received esse in a principle in receptive potency to it, or matter and form) or has some other being that causes its esse (CAUSE_2 at esse, tenseless), with no priority clause. C2 implies it; with the existing B3 (a distinct esse-cause is simply prior) it implies C2.
